factors.name: nvda_volume_surge_log
factors.hypothesis: The parent missed in 2022 and 2024 probably because a few extreme NVDA volume spikes dominate the linear scale; a log transform compresses those spikes so the signal reflects typical surges rather than outliers.

factors.name: aapl_volume_surge_vs_nvda_log
factors.hypothesis: The parent's gap is driven by extreme ratio spikes in either stock; taking logs of each ratio before subtracting makes the relative surge symmetric and less dominated by one-day outliers, which may fix the 2022 and 2024 misses.

factors.name: qqq_overnight_gap_1d
factors.hypothesis: The overnight gap in QQQ reflects news that arrives before the open and can lead Apple's next-day move; it is a QQQ-based measure, unlike the rejected Apple overnight gap.

factors.name: qqq_range_surge
factors.hypothesis: A same-day jump in the market's range relative to its own 20-day norm signals a shift in market regime that a plain 10-day range average did not capture.

factors.name: aapl_msft_range_ratio
factors.hypothesis: Pairing the MSFT-NVDA range ratio with Apple's range relative to MSFT isolates whether Apple itself is more volatile than its megacap peer, which may sharpen the market-level range signal.

factors.name: aapl_range_volatility_10d
factors.hypothesis: Pairing NVDA's volume surge with the variability of Apple's own daily range tests whether peer volume spikes matter more when Apple's intraday risk is already elevated.
